column1: # The libraries Ratchet & Clank (PAL) calls, by entry point, and what the port
# does with each (docs/port/RAC1_PAL_SURVEY.md, appendix B, has the evidence).
#   host: the port writes it: the shared replacement of that name
#         (port/game/common/libraries.tsv, lib/*.c), bound to this address by
#         hostgen (libraries.c); a signature here overrides the shared one.
#   game: the decompilation's C runs as it is (it only computes).
#   wrap: the decompilation's C runs, as <symbol>__game, under a host function
#         that does what the port needs around it (rac1/host/boot.c).
#   todo: needs a host version that is not written yet; it stays a stub.

the pad's report into its state, each poll: with the player's strafe on, in play on foot, L2 and R2 are kept for the strafe and taken out of the pad's button words, so the game does not look or crouch on them (L1 still looks, R1 still crouches) (rac1/host/strafe.c)
the stick into the hero, early in his update: with the player's strafe on and the hero standing in Lock, or in Hold after its swing, he is turned toward the camera first (rac1/host/strafe.c)

eases the facing toward the move yaw: with the player's strafe on and the hero strafing, toward the camera's yaw, or while Hold's swing lasts the facing latched when L2 or R2 went down (rac1/host/strafe.c)
the velocity along an angle, the facing for one above pi: while the hero strafes, along the move yaw (rac1/host/strafe.c)

the follow camera's requests from the hero's state: while the hero strafes, the strafe camera the game asks for in state 0x81 with L2 or R2 held, swung once behind the latched facing for Hold (rac1/host/strafe.c)
Ratchet's animation advance: while he strafes away from his facing, the walk or the run stepped back first so that it plays backwards (rac1/host/strafe.c)
the liquid grid's cull (seas, lava, sand): in a picture wider than the game's, against the cull matrix opened by as much as the picture is wider, put back after it (rac1/host/wide_view.c)

the bounding sphere view test: while a draw callback list or the nanotech cluster's update runs, in a picture wider than the game's, against clip constants opened by as much as the picture is wider, put back after it (rac1/host/wide_view.c)

the nanotech cluster's update (the orb on a nanotech crate), which draws it only while the bounding sphere test finds it in view: in a picture wider than the game's, that test against clip constants opened by as much as the picture is wider (rac1/host/wide_view.c)
the moby update loop: run by the host, which notes the moby whose turn it is (one store before, one after), so a crash report names the moby being updated (rac1/host/crash_state.c)

a scene's actors: run by the host, which skips an actor CreateMoby cannot make (the moby pool full) instead of reading through the null moby as the console does; a documented divergence (rac1/host/scene_actors.c, docs/port/KNOWN_ISSUES.md)
